text:
Leah: perf-bot flagged a p95 latency regression in nightly CI small-batch runs. link: https://bench.redwood/s/8842
perf-bot: [ALERT] nightly-ci-bench job=8842 p95 +28% vs baseline (since 185...)
Leah: assigning to eng-runtime to triage — @Sanjay can you take first pass?
Sanjay: on it. grabbing logs and reproducer. which command should I run locally?
Leah: minimal repro: `./ci/run_bench --profile small-batch --seed 42` job id 8842. also compare with baseline job 8827
Kevin: I can spin a local flamegraph. thoughts on likely culprits: batching or kv-cache behavior
Anya: FYI canary/replica group had normal numbers, only the nightly (serial) runner shows the spike
Sanjay: running bisect over commits bf4a3d2..c9e8f01
Sanjay: quick dump from job 8842 shows increased time in attention kernel and many small allocations
Kevin: pasted trace snippet:
```
[attention.cu:312] 80% CPU time
alloc_small(64B) x 120k
KV cache hits down ~5%
```
Sanjay: running `perf record` and `perf script` now, will attach flamegraph when ready
Leah: add a control run with `--cache-ttl=100` so we can rule out cache eviction side-effects
perf-bot: bisect started: range bf4a3d2 -> c9e8f01, current step bf4a3d2
Kevin: I reproduced locally; commit bf4a3d2 (batching refactor) increases p95 on small-batch by ~30%
Sanjay: reproducer + patch incoming. initial root cause: logic changed to combine tiny batches leading to more overhead per token
Leah: if patch looks good, prefer revert-first then rework. @Kevin can you open revert PR?
Kevin: prepping revert PR now. will target main revert for bf4a3d2, PR #1731
Anya: I'll add a nightly guard that fails CI when p95 > 15% vs baseline and opens a ticket
Sanjay: PR for fix posted, test run queued (job 8845). attaching flamegraph: https://flame.redwood/s/ff123
Kevin: revert PR #1731 merged, re-run job 8845 shows p95 back to baseline (+2%).
Leah: great. marking alert resolved. follow-up: add e2e small-batch regression test + metric guardrails. I'll file the follow-up ticket
Leah: thanks everyone :white_check_mark:
